messages:
maria: Heads-up — bumped the gpu-pool terraform module to v3.2.0 in gitops (PR merged an hour ago). Canary failed during staging rollout, looks like a KMS IAM conditional got introduced and caused plan drift on the VPC endpoints.
jon: Ugh, did the module add a new required var? I saw a `kms_key_binding` change in the diff.
alice: I reviewed the PR. It made `kms_key_id` optional but added an implicit `kms_role_arn` binding when not provided. See snippet:```hcl
resource "aws_kms_key" "gpu_cache" {
  policy = var.kms_key_id == null ? local.default_policy : data.aws_kms_key.existing.policy
}
module "gpu_pool" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@repo/infra-modules.git//gpu-pool?ref=v3.2.0"
  kms_key_id = var.kms_key_id
  // new behavior: if kms_key_id null, module creates key + role
}
```
sam: Staging canary logs show `aws_vpc_endpoint` wants to attach a principal: the new role created by the module. Our existing endpoint policy denies unknown principals -> drift.
ryan: So the module is creating resources in the customer's account path that our env doesn't expect. We should avoid auto-creating KMS keys in the module to keep idempotency for existing pools.
carol: Agreed. For Dedicated we usually require `kms_key_id` as explicit input. The change is too opinionated. Can we revert to v3.1.7 in the rollout or patch the module?
maria: I started a rollback PR to pin the gitops helmrelease to v3.1.7 for the canary namespace. Deploy-bot: can you halt the rest of the rollout? :eyes:
deploy-bot: @maria, canary pipeline paused for gpu-pool rollout (run 2026-11-12T14:45Z). Manual approval required to continue.
infra-qa: Quick suggestion: add a plan-only gate in the gitops pipeline that runs `terraform plan` against a staging workspace and diffs principals on endpoint policies before apply. That would have caught this.
jon: +1. Also we should add a module-versioning note in the README: breaking changes that create IAM principals must be opt-in via a var (e.g., create_kms = false).
alice: Patch plan: submit a hotfix to module to add `create_kms = bool` defaulting to false, and early-return for kms_role creation. I'll draft PR now and push.
sam: If alice pushes hotfix, we can re-run canary after smoke tests. Also check region constraints — the key creation path uses a KMS alias that isn't available in ap-northeast-1 in our infra test account, which might explain intermittent failures there.
carol: Good catch. Add region guard in module: `count = var.create_kms && contains(local.kms_supported_regions, var.region) ? 1 : 0`
ryan: Longer term: add a gitops policy (pre-merge CI) that detects any module diff that adds new IAM roles/principals or new-managed KMS keys and flags as "opt-in breaking". We keep accidental principal creation out of rollouts.
maria: Agreed. For now: (1) alice hotfix -> add create_kms flag, region guard; (2) pin canary back to v3.1.7; (3) add plan-only gate in pipeline and a simple linter check for new principals. I'll update the incident channel if anything else pops up. Thanks all. :heart:
